title: Australian High-Speed Rail Design and Management Concept
summary: A course project combining a five-person lightweight carbody design concept with an independently developed five-page front-end prototype for high-speed rail finance, risk, compliance, and impact workflows.
role: Carbody: Proposed Design · EngineerPlus: independent front-end prototype

engineeringDesign.title: Lightweight recycled carbon fiber carriage concept
engineeringDesign.summary: The team explored recycled carbon-fiber composites, honeycomb sandwich structures, and interfaces with an existing metal frame or chassis for selected non-critical carbody components. No measured train-level energy saving is established.

engineerPlus.title: EngineerPlus management concept
engineerPlus.summary: A static interface concept connecting capital allocation, risk simulation, compliance workflow, and impact reporting for an Australian high-speed rail scenario.
technology: Tailwind CSS via CDN in the original prototype
Leaflet and OpenStreetMap in the impact dashboard
limitations: Interface values are illustrative or randomly generated; they are not live financial, regulatory, emissions, or project data.
The risk calculation is an interaction demonstration, not a validated engineering or financial risk model.
The compliance workflow is simulated in the browser and does not connect to a blockchain network.
The prototype has no backend, authentication, persistence, or production deployment.

facts.publicText: Team report records my role as "Proposed Design"
Team concept focused on selected non-critical carbody components, layered composites, and interfaces with the existing metal frame or chassis
Independently designed and implemented the five-page EngineerPlus front-end concept prototype
EngineerPlus uses illustrative client-side data and simulated workflows; it has no backend or live service connection
